messages:
tara: Hi team — starting on-call next week. Two blockers: I don't have PagerDuty access, and the shadow checklist in the repo is a bit dense. Who's the right person to ping for a quick walkthrough?

felix: Welcome @tara. I can add you to PD and walk the checklist. Invite sent — check spam. If you don't get it in 5m, reply here and Ill re-send.

jordan: For a compact pre-shadow flow I give new folks: 1) confirm PD + mobile test, 2) clone runbooks and open the shadow-checklist.md, 3) run the dev reenact (one-liner below), 4) read one recent postmortem.

jordan: Dev reenact one-liner from runbooks:
```bash
kubectl apply -f tools/load-gen.yaml -n dev-shadow && sleep 20 && kubectl logs -f deploy/load-gen -n dev-shadow
```

oncall-trainer: We run a 30m bootcamp the morning of your first shadow. It covers acking etiquette, timeline notes, and how to write the running doc. Sign up: https://go/rw-oncall-bootcamp (pick the "shadow prep" slot).

tara: Thanks! Also: if a real pager fires during my shadow, what's the concrete escalation ladder? Short bullets please.

felix: Short ladder: 
- 0-10m: Own first response — ack in PD, post short context in #incidents, start the incident doc.
- 10-30m: If still open, notify secondary on PD and @oncall-lead in channel.
- 30-60m: If customer impact or P1, call the on-call lead and open the incident channel using the template.
- After: assign postmortem owner within 48h and schedule follow-up.

jordan: Also note: during shadow you should call for help early. We prefer escalation over firefighting alone. We'll do a live mock in the bootcamp.

tara: Perfect — I see the PD invite now. I'll join bootcamp and try the reenact tonight. Appreciate the fast responses!

ops-bot: Rotation updated: tara added to PagerDuty rotation week starting 2026-08-03. Notifications sent to: tara, felix, jordan.
